analysis_status: designed after the clean annual opportunity result and subseason effort audit were inspected; sensitivity only, not confirmatory
purpose: Test whether the clean annual focal-response-excluded current-opportunity association adds held-out information beyond focal-plant 5-min census effort.

effort_definition.note: 2010 raw count remains 463 rather than being coerced to the published 460.

preprocessing: log1p all four predictors, then z-score from training-fold moments
cross_validation: same leave-one-annual-transition-out strict-core, near-core and all-annual scopes as the repaired opportunity baseline
increment: effort-only log loss minus opportunity-plus-effort log loss

interpretation.allowed: whether clean current ecological opportunity adds predictive information beyond focal-plant census effort
forbidden: claiming census effort is exogenous to flowering availability

claim_ceiling: Post-result effort-adjustment sensitivity only. A positive opportunity increment can show that the clean opportunity association is not exhausted by focal-plant census counts, but it cannot identify true rewiring or remove all sampling-process dependence.
